1430-beautiful-stories-from-shakespeare.description: A book by E. Nesbit. These things considered, what wonder is it that the works of Shakespeare, next to the Bible, are the most highly esteemed of all the classics of English literature. “So extensively have the characters of Shakespeare been drawn upon by artists, poets, and writers of fiction,”  says an American author,--“So interwoven are these characters in the great body of English literature, that to be ignorant of the plot of these dramas is often a cause of embarrassment.”

arxiv-2103-11916.title: Stable Haptic Teleoperation of UAVs via Small ℒ 2 \mathcal{L}_{2} Gain and Control Barrier Functions
arxiv-2103-11916.creator: Dawei Zhang, Roberto Tron
arxiv-2103-11916.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Dawei Zhang, Roberto Tron. We present a novel haptic teleoperation approach that considers not only the safety but also the stability of a teleoperation system. Specifically, we build upon previous work on haptic shared control , which uses control barrier functions (CBFs) to generate a reference haptic feedback that informs the human operator on the internal state of the system, helping them to safely navigate the robot without taking away their control authority.

arxiv-2104-03295.title: Experimental Quantum Learning of a Spectral Decomposition
arxiv-2104-03295.creator: Michael R. Geller, Zoë Holmes, Patrick J. Coles, Andrew Sornborger
arxiv-2104-03295.description: Abstract Currently available quantum hardware allows for small scale implementations of quantum machine learning algorithms. Such experiments aid the search for applications of quantum computers by benchmarking the near-term feasibility of candidate algorithms. Here we demonstrate the quantum learning of a two-qubit unitary by a sequence of three parameterized quantum circuits containing a total of 21 variational parameters.

arxiv-2107-12690.title: On the complete convergence for sequences of dependent random variables via stochastic domination conditions and regularly varying functions theory
arxiv-2107-12690.creator: Nguyen Chi Dzung a and Lê Vǎn Thành b
arxiv-2107-12690.description: Abstract This note develops Rio’s proof [C. R. Math. Acad. Sci. Paris, 1995] of the rate of convergence in the Marcinkiewicz–Zygmund strong law of large numbers to the case of sums of dependent random variables with regularly varying normalizing constants. It allows us to obtain a complete convergence result for dependent sequences under uniformly bounded moment conditions.

arxiv-2112-09803.title: Optimization Study of Hydraulic Power Take-off System for an Ocean Wave Energy Converter
arxiv-2112-09803.creator: Erfan Amini, Hossein Mehdipour, Emilio Faraggiana, Danial Golbaz, Sevda Mozaffari, Giovanni Bracco, Mehdi Neshat ∗
arxiv-2112-09803.description: Abstract Ocean wave renewable energy is fast becoming a key part of renewable energy industries over the recent decades. By developing wave energy converters as the main converter technology in this process, their power take-off (PTO) systems have been investigated.

arxiv-2209-06041.title: Fast Metasurface Hybrid Lens Design using a Semi-Analytical Model
arxiv-2209-06041.creator: A. Cléroux Cuillerier, J. Borne, S. ThibaultCentre d’optique, photonique et laser, Université LavalUniversité LavalQuebec City, Canada
arxiv-2209-06041.description: Abstract We propose a new method for integrating metasurfaces in optical design using semi-analytical modelling of dielectric nanostructures. The latter computes the output phase of an electric field incident on the metasurface, allowing their use with ray-tracing software. This tool provides a method to use metasurfaces in optical systems while using built-in optimization processes to avoid time-consuming computation.

arxiv-2211-15972.title: Interlayer ferromagnetism and insulator-metal transition in element-doped CrI 3 thin films
arxiv-2211-15972.creator: Shiyang Sun ‡, Xuyan Chen ‡, Xuqi Li ‡, Huihui Zhang, Haidan Sang, Shifei Qi, Zhenhua Qiao
arxiv-2211-15972.description: Abstract The exploration of magnetism in two-dimensional layered materials has attracted extensive research interest. For the monoclinic phase CrI 3 with interlayer antiferromagnetism, finding a static and robust way of realizing the intrinsic interlayer ferromagnetic coupling is desirable. arxiv-2302-10624.title: Self-improving object detection via disagreement reconciliation
arxiv-2302-10624.creator: Gianluca Scarpellini, Stefano Rosa, Pietro Morerio, Lorenzo Natale, Alessio Del Bue
arxiv-2302-10624.description: Abstract Object detectors often experience a drop in performance when new environmental conditions are insufficiently represented in the training data. This paper studies how to automatically fine-tune a pre-existing object detector while exploring and acquiring images in a new environment without relying on human intervention, i.e., in a self-supervised fashion.

arxiv-2410-02144.title: SoundMorpher: Perceptually-Uniform Sound Morphing with Diffusion Model
arxiv-2410-02144.creator: Xinlei Niu, Jing Zhang, Charles Patrick Martin
arxiv-2410-02144.description: Abstract We present SoundMorpher, an open-world sound morphing method designed to generate perceptually uniform morphing trajectories. Traditional sound morphing techniques typically assume a linear relationship between the morphing factor and sound perception, achieving smooth transitions by linearly interpolating the semantic features of source and target sounds while gradually adjusting the morphing factor.

arxiv-2411-06840.title: Edge reconstruction of compressible Quantum Hall fluid in the filling fraction range 1/3 to 2/3
arxiv-2411-06840.creator: Suvankar Purkait, Tanmay Maiti, Pooja Agarwal, Suparna Sahoo, Sreejith G J, Sourin Das, Giorgio Biasiol, Lucia Sorba, Biswajit Karmakar
arxiv-2411-06840.description: Abstract Edge reconstruction of gate-tunable compressible quantum Hall fluids in the filling fraction range 1/3 to 2/3 is studied by measuring transmitted conductance of two individually excited fractional e 2 / 3 ​ h e^{2}/3h edge modes of bulk 2/3 fractional quantum Hall fluid.

arxiv-2503-16993.title: HEAPO – An Open Dataset for Heat Pump Optimization with Smart Electricity Meter Data and On-Site Inspection Protocols
arxiv-2503-16993.creator: Tobias Brudermueller, Marina González Vayá, Elgar Fleisch, Thorsten Staake
arxiv-2503-16993.description: Abstract . Heat pumps are essential for decarbonizing residential heating but consume substantial electrical energy, impacting operational costs and grid demand. Many systems run inefficiently due to planning flaws, operational faults, or misconfigurations. While optimizing performance requires skilled professionals, labor shortages hinder large-scale interventions.

arxiv-2507-03832.title: Impact of cosmic-ray propagation on the chemistry and ionisation fraction of dark clouds
arxiv-2507-03832.creator: G. Latrille ,, A. Lupi, S. Bovino, T. Grassi, G. Sabatini, M. Padovani
arxiv-2507-03832.description: Abstract Aims. A proper modelling of the cosmic-ray ionisation rate within gas clouds is crucial to describe their chemical evolution accurately. However, this modelling is computationally demanding because it requires the propagation of cosmic rays throughout the cloud over time.

arxiv-2510-26796.title: S e e 4 D : Pose-Free 4D Generation via Auto-Regressive Video Inpainting
arxiv-2510-26796.creator: Dongyue Lu, Ao Liang, Tianxin Huang, Xiao Fu, Yuyang Zhao, Baorui Ma, Liang Pan, Wei Yin, Lingdong Kong, Wei Tsang Ooi, Ziwei Liu
arxiv-2510-26796.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Dongyue Lu, Ao Liang, Tianxin Huang, Xiao Fu, Yuyang Zhao, Baorui Ma, Liang Pan, Wei Yin, Lingdong Kong, Wei Tsang Ooi, Ziwei Liu. Immersive applications call for synthesizing spatiotemporal 4D content from casual videos without costly 3D supervision. Existing video-to-4D methods typically rely on manually annotated camera poses, which are labor-intensive and brittle for in-the-wild footage.

arxiv-2512-17556.title: Observation of Fano-suppression in scattering resonances of bosonic erbium atoms
arxiv-2512-17556.creator: L. Lafforgue, N. P. Mehta, J.J.A. Houwman, F. Claude, S. T. Rittenhouse, F. Ferlaino, M. J. Mark
arxiv-2512-17556.description: Abstract The collisional properties of lanthanides exhibit remarkable complexity due to their many valence electrons, leading to an extraordinarily dense Feshbach spectrum showing signs of quantum chaos. Here we explore the situation of bosonic spin mixtures of erbium, adding the additional spin degree of freedom to the problem.

pmc-11381425.title: Dataset of Virginia Flue-cured Tobacco Leaf images based on stalk leaf position for classification tasks: A case of Tanzania
pmc-11381425.creator: Faith Nguleni, Devotha Nyambo, Jacob Lisuma, Shubi Kaijage
pmc-11381425.description: Nicotiana tabacum is a kind of plant cultivated for its leaves used for manufacturing medicine and cigarettes. With the common name, the Tobacco plant is grown in many countries including China, Indonesia, Malawi and Tanzania just to mention a few. Literatures suggest a technical gap in the proper identification of grade labels for various parts of the plant.

pmc-11436088.title: Augmented Physics-Based Models for High-Order Markov Filtering
pmc-11436088.creator: Shuo Tang, Tales Imbiriba, Jindřich Duník, Ondřej Straka, Pau Closas, Wei Yi
pmc-11436088.description: Hybrid physics-based data-driven models, namely, augmented physics-based models (APBMs), are capable of learning complex state dynamics while maintaining some level of model interpretability that can be controlled through appropriate regularizations of the data-driven component. In this article, we extend the APBM formulation for high-order Markov models, where the state space is further augmented with past states (AG-APBM).

pmc-11477883.title: Equal–Additive–Subtractive Remanufacturing Integrated Laser Directed Energy Deposition with Shot Peening and Machining Induced High Performance of Plunger Rod
pmc-11477883.creator: Xiaoyu Zhang, Wenping Mou, Dichen Li, Shaowei Zhu, Lianyu Li, Qiaochu Liu, Sheng Huang, Federico Mazzucato
pmc-11477883.description: The number of easily destroyed parts with high value is increasing in industry, and green remanufacture engineering is now mainstream in this new and expanding industrial field. Equal–additive–subtractive manufacturing, as a new technology that combines strengthening technology, additive manufacturing, and machining technology has great potential for development in the area of remanufacturing.

pmc-12581279.title: Visual rehabilitation of a fighter pilot by utilizing a combination of contact lenses: a case report
pmc-12581279.creator: Nir Erdinest, Yossi Eshel, Nadav Shemesh, Shoham Kubovsky, Moodi Kupperman, Shani Morad, David Landau, Itay Lavy
pmc-12581279.description: BackgroundPenetrating keratoplasty is often necessary when corneal scars impact the visual axis. Post-surgical irregular astigmatism resulting from corneal deformity may necessitate the use of rigid gas permeable or scleral contact lenses to enhance visual quality. However, lens fitting becomes challenging when irregularity involves the peripheral cornea.

pmc-12586357.title: The Stigmatisation of Men Who Have Sex With Men in the Spread of Mpox: Are We Repeating the Mistakes of HIV?
pmc-12586357.creator: David Bermejo‐Martínez, Enrique Castro‐Sánchez, Pilar Marqués‐Sánchez
pmc-12586357.description: The 2022 mpox outbreak disproportionately affected men who have sex with men (MSM), leading to targeted public health interventions. While data supported prioritising MSM, this focus risks reviving stigmatisation reminiscent of the HIV/AIDS crisis. This editorial examines the roots of this narrative and its potential negative impact on affected communities.

pmc-12697404.title: Success of pulpotomy with MTA in primary teeth: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12697404.creator: Tejal Laxman Beldar, Ashwin Muralidhar Jawdekar, Laresh Naresh Mistry
pmc-12697404.description: The challenge of effectively managing primary teeth with irreversible pulpitis in pediatric dentistry is of interest. The clinical and radiographic success of different pulpotomy materials, including Mineral Trioxide Aggregate (MTA), in comparison to conventional materials like formocresol, ferric sulfate, calcium hydroxide, and Biodentine is reported.

pmc-13083110.title: Bacillus megaterium supplementation improves growth performance, immunity, antioxidant capacity, and gut microbiota in cold-stressed neonatal calves
pmc-13083110.creator: Mengjian Liu, Zixuan Ye, Xucheng Mo, Yakun Wang, Siyu Li, Yaoli Fu, Yujie Niu
pmc-13083110.description: IntroductionNeonatal calves exhibit immature digestive and immune systems, rendering them susceptible to environmental stressors such as cold temperatures, which exacerbate gastrointestinal dysfunction and diarrhea incidence. Antibiotic use for mitigation poses risks, including microbiota disruption and resistance development, necessitating safe probiotic alternatives.

pmc-13276574.title: Chronic lead encephalopathy in an adult: A case report and literature review
pmc-13276574.creator: Tourby Rim, Sikkal Asmaa, Khattab Hajar, Haddouali Kamal, Bellakhdar Salma, El Moutawakil Bouchra, M.A. Rafai, El Otmani Hicham
pmc-13276574.description: We report the case of a 51-year-old man with lead encephalopathy due to chronic occupational exposure in fishing net manufacturing. Over three years, he developed cognitive decline, cerebellar ataxia, parkinsonism, and myoclonus. MRI showed bilateral hyperintensities T2/FLAIR sequences in deep brain structures, and elevated blood lead levels confirmed the diagnosis [2].

pmc-13523159.title: Single‐Session Combined Endodontic‐Periodontal Management of External Cervical Resorption: A 28‐Month Clinical and CBCT Follow‐Up
pmc-13523159.creator: Mercedes Elvira Marval Figueroa, Maria Antonieta Mendez Rodulfo, Jose Francisco Gomez-Sosa
pmc-13523159.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesExternal cervical resorption (ECR) is a progressive condition that may compromise both periodontal and pulpal tissues. This report describes the outcome of a single‐session combined endodontic‐periodontal approach for the management of ECR in a previously treated maxillary central incisor.Case PresentationA 41‐year‐old male presented with ECR affecting the maxillary left central incisor, associated with previous trauma, a sinus tract, and defective root canal treatment. Cone‐beam computed tomography (CBCT) was used for diagnosis, classification, and treatment planning.

pmc-13528345.creator: Marcos Luna Cervantes, Leandro García González, Julián Hernández Torres, Erick Octavio Santos Santiago, José Luis Zamora Navarro, Diana Jiménez Girón, Daniel de Jesús Araujo Pérez, Jorge Bertin Santaella González, Mario Alberto Díaz Solís, Pablo Thomas Dupont, Irma Yadira Izaguirre Hernández, Antoni
pmc-13528345.description: Graphical abstractKeywords: Pulsed Current Electrodeposition, Arduino-Based, Nanostructures, SERS Hardware in context Pulsed current electrodeposition (PCE) is an electrochemical synthesis strategy in which current pulses are alternated with relaxation intervals to control nucleation, growth, metal loading, spatial distribution, and final deposit morphology [1], [2], [3], [4].

pmc-13541850.title: Effect of a sodium fluoride rinse on the composition of early oral biofilms formed in situ on enamel and dentine
pmc-13541850.creator: Luciana Pisenti Berto, Jingyu Ding, Letícia Oba Sakae, Samira Helena Niemeyer, Richard Johannes Wierichs, Antônio Pedro Ricomini-Filho, Hendrik Meyer-Lueckel, Tommy Baumann, Thiago Saads Carvalho
pmc-13541850.description: ObjectivesDental caries results from dysbiotic shifts in the microbial community, so modulating biofilm composition represents a valid preventive strategy. The aim of this double-blind randomized crossover in situ study was to investigate how a fluoride rinse can modify the composition of the early oral biofilm formed on enamel and dentine.

pmc-13552300.title: Reconciling the Formal and Hidden Curricula in General Practice Training
pmc-13552300.creator: Ross Munro
pmc-13552300.description: This reflective letter explores the relationship between the formal curriculum and the hidden curriculum (HC) in UK general practice (GP) training. Drawing on personal experience, it highlights a perceived disconnect between curriculum content and the realities of day-to-day GP practice. While trainees acquire a broad range of knowledge, some learning feels only indirectly relevant to independent practice.
